nodes.name: Ag Nanocubes Synthesis
nodes.procedure: 10 mL of EG was added to a 100 mL round-bottom flask and heated in an oil bath at 150 °C with magnetic stirring. 0.12 mL of Na₂S solution (3 mM in EG) was added at 150 °C. After 2 min, 1 mL of HCl solution (3 mM in EG) was added into the heated solution, followed by the injection of 2.5 mL of PVP solution (25 mg mL⁻¹ in EG). After an additional 2 min, 0.8 mL of CF₃COOAg solution (300 mM in EG) was injected into the previously mentioned mixture. After reaction for 1.5 h, the mixture was centrifuged and washed twice in acetone and DI water to remove unreacted chemicals and EG, and was redispersed in 20 mL of DI water for further synthesis.

nodes.name: L/D-CAgAu Synthesis
nodes.procedure: In a typical process, a 20 mL glass vial containing 4 mL of DI water, 0.8 mL of CTAB solution (100 mM), and 150 μL of silver nanocube dispersion were mixed at 35 °C for 2 min. 280 μL of HAuCl₄ solution (10 mM) was subsequently injected to form an [AuBr₄⁻] complex, followed by a rapid addition of 400 μL of L-AA solution (100 mM) to reduce Au³⁺ to Au⁺. Then 150 μL of amino acids solution (L-Cys/D-Cys, 10 mM) was added to the mixture. The reaction was kept undisturbed at 35 °C for 1 h. L-CAgAu and D-CAgAu were obtained by centrifugation and rinsed three times with DI water and dried at 80 °C for 24 h.

nodes.name: L/D-CAgAuPt Synthesis
nodes.procedure: Typically, 6 mg of L-CAgAu/D-CAgAu was added into a 20 mL glass vial containing 5 mL of DI water and stirred uniformly. After 2 min, 250 μL of H₂PtCl₆ solution (10 mM) was added into the suspension. Afterward, 450 μL of L-AA solution (100 mM) was injected to the above mixture and fully reacted at 80 °C for 8 h. L-CAgAuPt and D-CAgAuPt were obtained by centrifugation and rinsed three times with DI water and dried at 80 °C for 24 h.

nodes.characterization_summary: TEM reveals Ag nanocubes ~80 nm, D-CAgAu with Au branches wrapping Ag nanocubes, D-CAgAuPt with 4-8 nm Pt nanoparticles uniformly anchored on Au branches, AgAu with epitaxial Au shell.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Fig. 1(b) shows the transmission electron microscopy (TEM) image of the uniform Ag nanocubes with the size about 80 nm. From the TEM images of L/D-CAgAu (Fig. 1c and Fig. S1), the L/D-Cys induced Au branches wrapped around Ag nanocubes could be clearly identified. Whereas Au without L/D-Cys induction only epitaxially grew a layer of Au shell on Ag nanocubes... The tiny Pt nanoparticles with a diameter of 4-8 nm were uniformly anchored on the Au branches in the TEM images of L/D-CAgAuPt.

properties.description: TEM image showing nanostructure with scale bar of 200 nm

nodes.characterization_summary: D-CAgAuPt shows intimate contact between Pt nanoparticles and Au branches with lattice spacings of 0.224 nm (Pt(111)) and 0.238 nm (Au(111)). Au branch tips of D-CAgAu exhibit high-curvature nanopyramid morphology.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Upon further inspection by high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM) in Fig. 1 (e), the intimate contact of Pt nanoparticles and Au branches of D-CAgAuPt could be more clearly observed... There were two sets of FFT patterns and corresponding atomic-resolution TEM images with lattice spacing of 0.224 nm and 0.238 nm, corresponding to the (111) plane of Pt and the (111) plane of Au.

properties.description: High-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM) image showing nanostructure

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM and EDS elemental mapping of D-CAgAuPt show homogeneous distribution of Ag, Au, and Pt elements.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-angle annular darkfield scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) image and corresponding elemental mapping images were depicted in Fig. 1(k), and the elements of Ag, Au, and Pt were homogeneously distributed on D-CAgAuPt.

nodes.characterization_summary: AgAu and L/D-CAgAu show diffraction peaks indexed to Au JCPDS 04-0784 and Ag JCPDS 04-0783. AgAuPt and L/D-CAgAuPt show consistent peaks with no observable Pt peaks due to low Pt content.
nodes.evidence_snippet: All the diffraction peaks of the AgAu and L/D-CAgAu could be well indexed to Au JCPDS 04-0784 and Ag JCPDS 04-0783... The XRD diffraction peak positions of AgAuPt and L/D-CAgAuPt were basically consistent with those of AgAu and L/D-CAgAu, and there was no observable peak associated with Pt JCPDS 04-0802.

nodes.characterization_summary: D-CAgAuPt XPS shows Ag 3d (373.8/367.8 eV), Au 4f (87.4/83.8 eV with negative shift vs D-CAgAu), S 2p (164.4/162.9 eV), Pt 4f Pt⁰ (75.9/72.3 eV), C 1s (288.4/286.2/284.8 eV), N 1s (402.5/399.8 eV) confirming electronic structure modulation by Pt incorporation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the high-resolution Ag 3d XPS spectra of D-CAgAuPt (Fig. 2c), the binding energies at 373.8 and 367.8 eV could be assigned to Ag 3d3/2 and Ag 3d5/2. The high-resolution Au 4f XPS spectra of D-CAgAuPt exposed two binding energy peaks at 87.4 and 83.8 eV... In the high-resolution Pt 4f XPS spectrum of D-CAgAuPt (Fig. 2h), a pair of double peaks centered at 75.9 and 72.3 eV could be indexed to Pt 4f5/2 and Pt 4f7/2 peaks of Pt⁰.
